source.scope: Full source-bound validation asset only; no product install, registration or runtime acceptance

timing.scope: One observed wall-clock sample from first worker spawn through both completed jobs, including download, validation and publication. Not a download-only speed or comparative speedup benchmark.

scope: Two actual product CLI workers download two pinned public ModelScope single-file jobs. Global file and HTTP slot occupancy is observed through Windows file locks. Multi-file sequencing, sibling failure, checkpoint/space credit preservation, bounded Range reordering and fallback use synthetic valid shard fixtures and controlled response streams. Actual multi-component model acceptance and performance tuning remain pending.
